mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_delete_request (story_id, requester_id, reason, status) VALUES (#{storyId},#{requesterId},#{reason},0)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_delete_request WHERE story_id=#{storyId} AND status=0

SELECT r.req_id,r.story_id,r.requester_id,r.reason,r.status,r.create_time, s.title AS story_title, u.nickname AS requester_name FROM story_delete_request r JOIN story s ON r.story_id=s.story_id JOIN `user` u ON r.requester_id=u.user_id WHERE r.status=0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE story_delete_request SET status=#{status}, handle_user_id=#{handleUserId}, handle_result=#{handleResult}, handle_time=NOW() WHERE req_id=#{reqId}
